rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with appropriate comments on blastocoel, thinning zona, visible ICM, and cohesive TE, while acknowledging single-image limitations. Slightly generic and somewhat reliant on the provided Gardner grade rather than image-only specifics.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, BMI, semen quality, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: strong morphology and lining are balanced against age-related aneuploidy risk and endometriosis, and the probability estimate follows from these factors.

Generally aligns well with Gardner grading principles and common IVF guidance, including single embryo transfer and cautious discussion of PGT-A. Minor overreach includes speculative benefit claims around endometriosis suppression/surgery without case-specific severity details.

Provides clear, practical recommendations for current transfer management, follow-up after failure, PGT-A discussion, stimulation review, uterine evaluation, and lifestyle optimization with appropriate nuance.
